purpose: Teach: カンファレンス/コマーシャル/プロバイダー/申し入れ/立候補/過半数/申立/処遇

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界カンファレンスに参加しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we attend the industry conference.
lines.style: Clear, forward-looking. Slight nod of certainty. Brisk pace without rushing. Setting an agenda item with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。テレビコマーシャルの効果を分析中です
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently analyzing the effectiveness of our TV commercial.
lines.style: Focused and earnest. Steady eye contact. Professional but warm — showing he's already on it. Matter-of-fact delivery, no flourish.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロバイダーを変更する案を検討しましょう
lines.en: Let's think through the proposal to switch providers.
lines.style: Collaborative tone. Measured pace. Inviting input without demanding it. The cadence of someone who values the team's input on decisions.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様からの申し入れに迅速対応します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we respond quickly to any customer requests.
lines.style: Affirming with a slight lean-in. Sincere commitment without over-promising. Even rhythm that suggests reliability built into his baseline.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員の表彰候補に立候補を促しましょう
lines.en: Let's encourage eligible staff to put themselves forward for the employee recognition program.
lines.style: Thoughtful directive. Slight pause before the last clause — choosing words with care. Warm underneath the professionalism. The tone of someone who means what she says about recognition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。重要案件は過半数の合意で進めましょう
lines.en: Yes. We'll move forward on major decisions once we have majority agreement.
lines.style: Steady and clear. The confidence of someone laying out process. Not defensive about needing consensus — it's just how things work here. Even-keeled finish.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 労組からの申立に丁寧に対応しましょう
lines.en: Let's be sure to respond thoughtfully to any appeals from the union.
lines.style: Measured and careful. Not rushing through sensitive territory. Dignified pace. The attention of someone who recognizes this matters and deserves genuine care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人の処遇制度を整えております
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently finalizing the new compensation framework for new hires.
lines.style: Quiet competence. Almost closing-statement delivery. The last note of a well-organized briefing. Slight sense of completion, work nearly done.
